text:
PagerBot: ALERT: hosted-api p99 latency spike and inference queue growth in us-east-1. queue depth > 18k for the last 3m, GPU pool 97% utilized. paging oncall.
Jordan: on it, pinging infra. any customer-facing 5xxs yet?
Priya: seeing elevated 504s from the edge logs, mostly short-running RTU customers. p95 ~ 12s, p99 ~ 38s.
Liam: autoscaler logs show repeated FailedCreate for gpu nodes from the cloud API — quota errors and transient provisioning timeouts. autoscaler kept retrying then hit max-surge.
Ava: marking incident in #incident-ops. INC-2026-2401 created.
Carlos: adding initial impact: 7 customers reporting timeouts, one enterprise (cust: RedwoodBank) hit 30% error rate.
Jordan: immediate mitigations? can we route low-priority traffic to the cheap-fallback model (cpu) and free GPUs?
Priya: we have a fallback route but it's disabled for this tier. flipping it now for short-term mitigation.
Priya: /ops run enable-fallback-route --scope=low-tier --to=cpu-fallback
OpsBot: Command accepted. Fallback route enabled for low-tier. Expected token throughput freed ~22%.
Liam: also throttling non-paid burst clients by 3x to reduce queue. applying token_bucket limits at edge.
Jordan: try bumping autoscaler max-replicas as emergency? current max=60, can we raise to 90?
Priya: cloud quota won't allow above 72 without quota request, but we can increase pool max to 72 immediately. doing it now.
Priya: /infra set-gpu-pool-max --region=us-east-1 --pool=hosted-prod --max=72
OpsBot: GPU pool max updated to 72. Provisioner will attempt scale.
Liam: deploy logs show provisioner rate limit errors: 429 from cloud-provisioner when creating instances. we need to slow retries to avoid hitting backoff.
Jordan: slowing provisioner concurrency: /infra set-provisioner-concurrency --region=us-east-1 --concurrency=8
Priya: done. reducing hammering should reduce 429s, but that also slows fixes. still worth it to stabilize.
Carlos: customer comms: sending an update to RedwoodBank and affected customers now. brief: "We're seeing a traffic-driven GPU provisioning issue causing higher latency; mitigations in progress."
Ava: posting status update to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded — high latency in us-east-1. Working on scaling and fallback routes."
Liam: observed an autoscaler leader election every ~45s, leader pod OOMKilled a couple times. pulling leader logs.
Priya: grabbing leader logs:
```
E0321 15:12:05 provisioner.go:412] FailedCreateInstance: quotaExceeded: Quota limit reached for GPU vCPUs
E0321 15:12:21 leader-election.go:89] leader lost, restarting
E0321 15:13:11 provisioner.go:212] rate limit 429 CloudAPI CreateInstance
```
Priya: looks like a combination of quota + provisioner throttling.
Jordan: plan: 1) keep fallback enabled 2) throttle low-tier 3) raise pool to 72 4) slow provisioner retries 5) open quota emergency with cloud sales (but that's slower). anything else?
Liam: we should also enable model-variant fallback on the model-serving side — route long prompts to quantized variant which uses fewer GPU resources.
Priya: enabling model-variant fallback for hosted-rtu route. /runtime enable-variant --route=hosted-rtu --variant=quantized-v1
OpsBot: Variant enabled. Expected GPU memory drop ~28% per session.
Carlos: after actions: queue depth dropped to 9.2k, p95 down to 8.4s, p99 down to 20.8s. error rate for RedwoodBank down to 12%.
Jordan: good. keep throttles and fallbacks until autoscaler stabilizes. Estimating full recovery timeline ~30-40m.
Ava: prepping an incident bridge at 15:30 for postmortem. joining: Jordan, Priya, Liam, infra lead (TBD).
Priya: oncall handoff note for night: if queue climbs above 10k for >10m, do automated tier-throttle and escalate to infra-lead.
Liam: created a short-lived circuit-breaker to avoid cascading latencies: /runtime set-circuit-breaker --route=hosted-api --threshold=15000 --action=return-429
OpsBot: Circuit-breaker configured for hosted-api.
Jordan: any sign of regional failover? can we route some traffic to eu-west-1 temporarily?
Priya: cold start latency in eu-west is ok, but models not warmed across all variants. can warm the small pool and reroute ~15% traffic. doing it now.
Priya: /infra warm-pool --region=eu-west-1 --pool=hosted-prod-small --minutes=10
OpsBot: Warm pool started. Estimated warm time 6m.
Carlos: customer update sent: "We have applied temporary mitigations including routing lower-priority requests to fallback models and throttling burst traffic. We expect progressive recovery in the next 20-40 minutes."
Jordan: reminder to collect metrics snapshot (p50/p95/p99, queue depth, GPU utilization) every 5m and attach to the incident.
Liam: attaching snapshot: p50 120ms, p95 8.4s, p99 20.8s, queue 9.2k, GPU util 84%.
Ava: thanks. starting timeline capture.
Priya: autoscaler now provisioning; new nodes creating, some success, some still 429. provider acknowledged throttles but not increasing quota automatically. opened support case CS-987654.
Jordan: escalation to SRE lead: @Carlos please join for decisions on longer-term config changes (max_replicas, provisioner backoff).
Carlos: on it, joining bridge. initial ask: increase soft limit max_replicas, add jitter to retries, and add per-tenant circuit-breakers to avoid single-customer blasts.
Liam: will open a follow-up ticket to tune model-variant thresholds and pre-warm heuristics based on historical load spikes.
Ava: status update: "Mitigations showing improvement; partial recovery. We will keep throttles and fallbacks until autoscaler fully recovered."
Jordan: for the postmortem action list: 1) add quota-safety playbook 2) increase default fallback coverage 3) set autoscaler conservative backoff 4) add warm-pool automation for cross-region overflow 5) enforce per-tenant rate-limits.
Priya: agree. I'll own playbook + provider quota request follow-up.
Carlos: rounding out impact numbers for communications: ~900k requests impacted across 45m window, peak 30% error rate for one customer, overall platform p99 increased from 0.9s to 20s.
Jordan: closing note: incident moved to monitoring state. if metrics regress we'll reopen paging. good job team. :thumbsup:
PagerBot: Incident INC-2026-2401 status: monitoring.
Ava: will schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 PT. invites to follow.
Jordan: handoff to night oncall: Priya will be primary. Priya: any special notes for night?
Priya: keep circuit-breaker threshold at 15k, fallback enabled, pause auto-promotions for new clients, escalate if queue > 10k for 10m.
Carlos: filing primary action items in the incident tracker.
Ava: thanks all, handing off channel to Priya.
Priya: taking handoff. signing off here in 10 to update notes.
OpsBot: Channel locked to incident participants.
Priya: logged final note and will update postmortem doc.
Jordan: thanks — closing thread.
